"Ukraine war briefing: Russia attacks multiple power plants after Trump energy ceasefire claim"
Standfirst: "Zelenskyy says Ukrainian skies filled with Russian drones after truce claim, which Moscow has yet to confirm, as six killed in strikes. What we know on DAY 1,692"
Photo credit: Andrii Marienko/AP (caption: "Cars burn after a Russian strike on a residential neighbourhood in Kharkiv, where three people were killed on Sunday. A power plant in the north-eastern Ukrainian city was also hit.")

WHAT WAS STRUCK AND WHERE (all attributed to Zelenskyy on social media):
- A DRONE hit a POWER PLANT IN KYIV on Sunday, "leading to POWER OUTAGES IN THE CAPITAL".
- Shortly after, a strike on the CHP-5 POWER PLANT in the eastern city of KHARKIV.
- Zelenskyy: "Ukrainian skies have been infested with Russian 'shaheds' [drones] all day."
NOTE: no customer/household outage figure given, and NO on-the-record statement from Ukraine's grid operator (Ukrenergo) or energy ministry in this piece. Outage detail is Zelenskyy's account only. Do not invent a figure.
(Companion Guardian piece gives Zelenskyy's fuller figures: thermal power station No 5 in Kharkiv, "the latest of more than 200 strikes this week against electricity generation and transmission facilities", plus "another 17 hits on gas and oil facilities".)

TRUMP'S CLAIM: "effective immediately, there is an energy ceasefire in the war between Russia and Ukraine". "Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!" - Truth Social, Sunday MORNING in Washington, no further details.
Zelenskyy expressed surprise, said the deal was "news to me", sought further details. "RUSSIA HAS YET TO CONFIRM IT AGREED."
WHITE HOUSE RESPONSE: none reported here. The BBC piece says only "The BBC has asked the White House for further details." NOTHING from Washington responding to its own announcement being contradicted - treat as unanswered, do not assert a response.

ALLIED SUPPORT: UK, France, Canada and the European Commission.
UK PM ANDY BURNHAM said a sustained energy ceasefire was "the best route to get energy and fuel back into world markets".
French President EMMANUEL MACRON said Paris supported a "real energy ceasefire".
Canadian PM MARK CARNEY, after a Sunday call with Zelenskyy, said the diesel deal "is in direct opposition to the efforts of Ukraine, Canada and our allies to create peace and stability in Europe".
EU chief URSULA VON DER LEYEN backed Zelenskyy "as he leads the fight for his people's freedom". German Foreign Minister JOHANN WADEPHUL said Berlin continued to "fully support" him.

CASUALTIES SUNDAY: Russian attacks killed SIX people in two Ukrainian cities, per Ukrainian officials - including a strike on a GROCERY STORE in KHARKIV (Ukraine's second-largest city) where THREE died and 20 were injured, TWO CHILDREN among the injured, per regional governor OLEH SYNIEHUBOV. In a separate attack in WESTERN Ukraine, officials said a Russian strike killed three people.
A Ukrainian drone killed one person in Russia's BELGOROD region (drone struck a car on a road near the border, per Belgorod operational HQ). In Russian-held DONETSK, Moscow-installed officials said one person was killed in a Ukrainian attack.
Russia's military said it struck a logistics centre in the town of TERNIVKA, MYKOLAIV region, and a cargo vessel in the Black Sea - claiming the centre stored military and dual-use cargoes (Russian defence ministry claim, Sunday).
Trump: "time for Ukraine to get a new president" who would finally settle the war. Zelenskyy to ABC News Sunday: "First of all, with all respect to President Trump, it's up to our society, up to our people to choose one or another leader."
SECOND-HAND (ft.com, blocked - do not cite): Trump administration threatening to stop the procurement system supplying Ukraine with weapons to press Kyiv to halt deep strikes; US lobbying European capitals and Kyiv to end attacks on Russian oil refineries.
